# filenamr

The goal of filenamr is to help in creating and modifying file names and
paths. It also supports reading and writing EXIF metadata. It is
primarily useful for the development of packages that work with file
reading and writing and need some utilities to support this goal.

## Installation

You can install the development version of filenamr like so:

``` r

pak::pkg_install("elipousson/filenamr")
```

## Making file names

The
[`make_filename()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/make_filename.md)
function is design for creating structured file names based on a name
and optional label, prefix, or postfix:

``` r

library(filenamr)

make_filename(
  name = "Neighborhoods",
  label = "Baltimore, MD"
)
#> [1] "baltimore_md_neighborhoods"

make_filename(
  prefix = "Plot",
  name = "Neighborhoods",
  label = "Baltimore, MD"
)
#> [1] "plot_baltimore_md_neighborhoods"

make_filename(
  prefix = "date",
  name = "Neighborhoods",
  label = "Baltimore, MD",
  postfix = "map",
  fileext = "jpeg"
)
#> [1] "2023-03-24_baltimore_md_neighborhoods_map.jpeg"
```

You can also pass a filename with an extension or path (setting
`create = TRUE` to create a directory if no directory already exist):

``` r

make_filename(
  filename = "baltimore_neighborhoods",
  path = "data",
  fileext = "pdf",
  create = FALSE
)
#> [1] "data/baltimore_neighborhoods.pdf"
```

If you provide a number as part of a filename, you can use the increment
parameter to create a filename where the number is replaced with a
larger number:

``` r

make_filename(
  filename = "plot",
  postfix = "1",
  increment = TRUE,
  fileext = "png"
)
#> [1] "plot_2.png"

make_filename(
  filename = "plot",
  postfix = "1",
  increment = 2,
  fileext = "png"
)
#> [1] "plot_3.png"
```

## Working with file metdata

This package uses the exiftoolr package (installing the development
version on GitHub is recommended) to support reading and writing EXIF,
IPTC, and XMP-DC metadata.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_file_overwrite()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/check_file_overwrite.md)
  : Check if a file exists and remove file or error
- [`check_path_fileext()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/check_path_fileext.md)
  : Check if a file path has a file extension
- [`default_exif_tags`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/default_exif_tags.md)
  : Default EXIF, XMP-dc, and IPTC tags
- [`default_exif_xwalk`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/default_exif_xwalk.md)
  : EXIF data column name crosswalk
- [`fmt_exif_direction()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/fmt_exif_direction.md)
  : Format a data.frame column as a cardinal direction in degrees and
  wind direction
- [`get_data_dir()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/get_data_dir.md)
  [`list_path_filenames()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/get_data_dir.md)
  : Check if data directory exists and create a new directory if needed
- [`get_path_fileext()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/get_path_fileext.md)
  [`list_path_fileext()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/get_path_fileext.md)
  : Get file extensions for files at a path
- [`list_pkg_data()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/list_pkg_data.md)
  [`list_pkg_datasets()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/list_pkg_data.md)
  [`list_pkg_extdata()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/list_pkg_data.md)
  [`list_pkg_cachedata()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/list_pkg_data.md)
  : List package datasets, extdata files, and files in package cache
- [`make_filename()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/make_filename.md)
  : Make file name and path with optional label, prefix, or postfix
- [`read_exif()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/read_exif.md)
  [`write_exif()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/read_exif.md)
  : Read EXIF metadata to create a simple feature object or write EXIF
  metadata to image files
- [`set_file_path()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/set_file_path.md)
  : Set a file path and validate path file extension
- [`str_affix()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/str_affix.md)
  [`str_prefix()`](https://elipousson.github.io/filenamr/reference/str_affix.md)
  : Apply a prefix or postfix to a string
